title: Create compaction router — FastAPI endpoints for compact + status
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/memory/{project}/compact — triggers compaction pass, returns report
GET /api/memory/{project}/compact/status — returns compaction status from memory
Loads memory, runs epoch identification + compaction, saves result
Translates domain errors to HTTP (404 NOT_FOUND, 422 VALIDATION_ERROR)
CompactionError raised at IO boundary when save fails
No silent failures — all error paths logged and returned
